newsitem.title: USA: Kaiser Perm uses Matritech bladder test.
newsitem.headline: Kaiser Perm uses Matritech bladder test.

text.p: Matritech Inc said Wednesday health care organization Kaiser Permanente in Southern California has adopted Matritech's NMP22 Test Kit to monitor all of its bladder cancer patients for disease recurrence.
According to Matritech, the NMP22 Test is the only quantitative, non-invasive urine test for transitional cell carcinoma, the type of cancer responsible for 90 percent of bladder cancers.
The company said the recurrence rate for bladder cancer is about 70 percent, so patients must be monitored frequently to detect a recurrence as early as possible.
More than two million people worldwide suffer from bladder cancer.
